newsitem.title: USA: Miami Computer sets Northwest move.
newsitem.headline: Miami Computer sets Northwest move.

text.p: Miami Computer Supply Corp said Wednesday it has agreed to an acquisition that will provide the company with a significant entry into the U.S. Northwest market with an immediate addition to earnings.

The company said it plans to acquire the computer supply and office automation business of Imperial Data Supply Corp for undisclosed terms. Headquartered in Spokane, Wash., Imperial has offices in Idaho Falls, Idaho, and Missoula, Montana.
Chief Financial Officer Michael E. Peppel said, "This acquisition provides a significant entry for Miami Computer into the Northwest market and will be accretive to our earnings immediately."
John L. Keegan, president of Imperial, will join the Miami Computer, the company said.
